residency.test: Resident if you have your permanent home in Finland or stay for more than six consecutive months.
residency.three_year_rule: Finnish citizens who move abroad are generally still treated as resident for the year of departure and the three following years unless they show no substantial ties.
residency.key_employee_regime: Foreign key employees can elect a 32% flat tax on Finnish salary for up to 48 months.

headline.municipal_tax: about 7.5% on average since the 2023 wellbeing services reform moved most of it to the state
headline.employee_contributions: roughly 9% covering pension, unemployment and health insurance

local_tax.name: Kunnallisvero (municipal tax)
local_tax.note: national average for 2025; municipal rates fell sharply in 2023 when healthcare funding moved to the wellbeing services counties

standard_deduction.name: Tulonhankkimisvähennys
standard_deduction.note: automatic income acquisition deduction; claim actual expenses instead if higher

employer.name: Unemployment insurance
employer.note: higher rate above the payroll threshold

self_employed.name: YEL entrepreneur pension
self_employed.note: based on declared YEL income, not actual profit

capital_gains.rate: 30% up to 30,000 of capital income, 34% above
capital_gains.deemed_acquisition_cost: you may deduct 20% of the sale price instead of the actual cost, or 40% if the asset was held over ten years - often better than the real figure
capital_gains.principal_residence: exempt if it was your permanent home for at least two years
capital_gains.small_sales: sales totalling under 1,000 in a year are exempt

quirks: The tax card (verokortti) sets your withholding rate. Exceeding your estimated annual income means the higher additional rate applies, so updating the card mid-year when you get a raise is standard practice.
The deemed acquisition cost rule lets you claim 20% or 40% of the sale price as cost without any documentation, which frequently beats the real acquisition cost for long-held assets.
Municipal tax rates dropped by roughly 12 percentage points in 2023 when healthcare moved to the counties. Comparisons with older figures are misleading.
Church tax of 1% to 2.25% applies to members of the Lutheran or Orthodox church and is collected with income tax.

The YEL pension contribution for the self-employed is charged on a declared income figure that also determines your future pension and sickness benefits - setting it too low is a common and costly mistake.

reporting.who_must_file: Everyone receives a pre-completed return. If it is correct, no action is needed; if anything is missing or wrong you must correct it by your personal deadline.

deadlines.what: Pre-completed tax return published in MyTax
Correction deadline - one of three dates in May, printed on your own return
Deadline for self-employed and business operators
Update your tax card in MyTax whenever income changes

forms.name: Tax card setting the withholding rate

documents_to_collect: Finnish personal identity code and online banking or mobile ID for MyTax
The pre-completed return, which contains salary, benefits and Finnish investment income
Broker statements for foreign securities - not pre-filled
Records of commuting costs above the 750 threshold and of work-related expenses
Mortgage interest details (deductibility on home loans was fully phased out from 2023 - check the current position)
Household deduction (kotitalousvähennys) invoices for domestic help and renovation

penalties.negligence: punitive tax increase of 2% to 10% of the added income
penalties.interest: late payment interest at the reference rate plus 7 percentage points

warnings: The earned income deduction (ansiotulovähennys) and basic deduction (perusvähennys) are not modelled, so results at low incomes overstate the tax.
Wellbeing services county funding is inside the state rates shown here; do not add it separately.
